restaurantName: Jit Seng Hong Kong Roasted Duck Rice
bio: The chef-owner started his own business after years as a chef in a larger restaurant. Open for three hours a day, the shop is famous for his roasted duck with deep-red skin and juicy meat, for which customers are prepared to queue. The roasted pork belly and char siew are tasty extras....
pageTitle: Jit Seng Hong Kong Roasted Duck Rice
